[[File:Horatio.png|thumb|250px|Horatio]] '''Horatio''' (Japanese: '''アキヒロ''' ''Akihiro'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He debuted in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]]. His first opponent was [[Simeon]], whom he defeated and advanced to the next round of the tournament. He appeared again in ''[[BW091|Battling Authority Once Again!]]'', where he battled {{an|Cilan}} in that round and lost. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Horatio |pkmn=Cinccino |img=Horatio Cinccino.png |type1=Normal |epnum=BW090 |epname=Jostling for the Junior Cup! |vaen=Michele Knotz |desc={{p|Cinccino}} was the first Pokémon that Horatio used in the Junior Cup. It was able to defeat Simeon's {{p|Zebstrika}} and advanced its {{pkmn|Trainer}} to the second round. There, it went up against [[Cilan's Stunfisk]] and lost to a {{m|Sludge Bomb}}. Cinccino's only known move is {{m|Giga Impact}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Horatio has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] - Top 8 (''[[BW091|Battling Authority Once Again!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=福圓美里 ''[[Misato Fukuen]]'' |en=[[Marc Thompson]] |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |es_la=José Antonio Toledano |es_eu=Inés Blázquez}}
